notes.title: Now you can skip Battles
notes.notes:
Hello there Ziel here. We have heard many comments from our players that ask for a way to avoid the battles completly, mostly to be able to replay the game and get the missing endings. 
 
It took a while to get there but finally the update is here, and with it also come a few languages corrections. Hopefully all of this will make your experience with the game more enjoyable. 

Thank you for all of your suport.

notes.title: Boss Rush is here!
notes.notes:
Hello! Ziel here. Finally summer sale is here, and with it comes the boss rush free DLC, a new achievement and many new images to unlock. 

Also the game will have 20% discount for the sale, so if you are interest on it but haven't tried before, this is the best time!

Please help us continue growing and making better games. 

Edit: A brief description of the Boss rush. First of all you need to have finished the main game to unlock it.

Defeat all bosses in "original" difficulty consecutively while avoiding your life bar to reach zero. You recover life and ki after defeating each boss.

You can exceed the 3000 pts of the life bar. (go beyond the maximum of 3000) 
You can exceed the 1500 pts of the ki bar. (go beyond the maximum of 1500)
You can exceed the 10 pts of the super bar up to the double (20)
